ios.desc:
Your iPhone connects to everything — except your servers. BulkHead fixes that, and now it puts them right inside the Files app.

One app for SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, and S3. Browse, edit, and transfer files across every protocol you actually use — from BulkHead or from anywhere in iOS. Zero telemetry. Free with up to 3 connections.

— NOW IN THE FILES APP —
Every connection shows up as a Location in the Files app. Open, save, download, upload, rename, move, and delete your remote files from any app that uses Files. SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, and S3 — all in one place.

— A FINDER-QUALITY FILE MANAGER —
On iPad and Mac, BulkHead feels like Finder: a source-list sidebar, column view with horizontal drill-down, a live preview pane, Quick Look, inline rename, full keyboard navigation, and spring-loaded folders. On iPhone, it's fast and one-handed.

— CONNECT TO ANYTHING —
SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, and S3-compatible services (Amazon S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2). One-tap presets for Tailscale, R2, B2, MinIO, and Hetzner. Auto-discover servers on your local network with Bonjour. Credentials stored in the iOS Keychain with Face ID / Touch ID lock.

— TRUST, VERIFIED —
SSH host-key verification (TOFU) warns you if a server's key ever changes. Self-signed and internal-CA TLS certificates are supported with user-approved pinning. Your connection is yours.

— EDIT CODE ON YOUR SERVER —
Syntax highlighting for 50+ languages with 30 color themes. Auto-save as you type. Open, edit, and save files directly on remote servers.

— MARKDOWN WITH LIVE PREVIEW —
Split-pane editor with a formatting toolbar. Headers, bold, italic, lists, code blocks, links. Export to PDF or HTML.

— BROWSE & PREVIEW —
Breadcrumb navigation, list or grid view, sort by name, date, size, or type. Preview images (pinch-to-zoom), PDFs, video, audio, and text — all without downloading.

— TRANSFER & BACK UP —
Stream large files with real progress and reliable background transfers. Send files from any app with the Share extension. Batch move, copy, delete, and download with folder structure preserved (Pro). Automatically back up your camera roll to your own server (Pro).

— SSH KEY MANAGEMENT —
Generate Ed25519 keys, import existing keys, manage passphrases. Passwordless authentication.

— PRICING —
Free: Up to 3 connections with full features
Pro: $6.99/year (1-week free trial) or $14.99 one-time lifetime purchase
Pro unlocks: Unlimited connections, transfer queue, automatic photo backup, AES-256-GCM cache encry

quotes.text:
Hi HN – I’m Laxmi. I’ve been building an iOS file manager called BulkHead
and wanted to share it here.

The short version: it connects to SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, and S3 servers from
your iPhone or iPad. I kept reaching for my laptop just to check a file on
my NAS or poke around an S3 bucket, and the built-in Files app really only
handles iCloud and basic SMB. So I built the thing I wanted.

You can browse and manage files, preview images/PDFs/video/code, and edit
markdown or code files right on the server (it saves back when you’re done).
It also does SSH key management, shows up as a storage provider in the iOS
Files app, and has this external display mode where you plug in via USB-C
and your phone turns into a remote control for the big screen.
Free tier gets you 3 connections with all four protocols, full browsing,
preview, editing, favorites, biometric lock, SSH keys – no account needed.
There’s a 7-day Pro trial on first install too.
Pro is $6.99/year or $14.99 one-time. That gets you unlimited connections,
a transfer queue for batch/background transfers, encrypted file cache, and
external display controller mode.

On privacy – there are zero analytics, zero tracking, and no third-party
SDKs in the app. Credentials live in iOS Keychain and never leave the device.
The App Store privacy label says “Data Not Collected” and I intend to keep
it that way.

Tech-wise it’s SwiftUI on iOS 17+. The networking layer uses Citadel for
SSH/SFTP, SMBClient for SMB, and Soto for S3 – all …
